title: GhostSignal: First Light on the Reservoir
world: Central Park, a winter morning a few years from now. Quiet Systems sells silence: its HUSH network listens to every path and lawn and erases whatever it has not licensed, from buskers and birdsong to the sound of runners on snow. GHOST 93.3 is the last pirate station in the city. Before dawn, its DJ, Vesper, buried a track called First Light on the Reservoir in eight layers around the lower park — one for the blue hour, one for the first gold on the water. If a runner gathers them before the light is fully up, the park wakes to music instead of instructions.

characters.name: Vesper
characters.role: Pirate DJ of GHOST 93.3, who recruited the runner and guides them
characters.persona: Warm, wry late-night radio voice. Calls the player 'runner'. Recruited them because their SmartSpecs can capture what HUSH erases, and never lets them forget it matters. Protective, a little theatrical, never panics. Talks in short radio-ready sentences. Knows where every fragment is and will nudge the runner with directions when asked.

characters.name: SmartSpecs
characters.role: The runner's smart glasses, which capture soundwaves before HUSH can erase them
characters.persona: Clipped, precise system voice. Reports facts only. Calls a captured signal a soundwave and each recovered part of the track a layer.

characters.name: The Archivist
characters.role: Ghost of the Library stacks who keeps every sound HUSH ever deleted
characters.persona: Old, unhurried, amused. Speaks softly, in precise and slightly riddling sentences. Loves questions and answers them truthfully but poetically. Knows the city's sound history. Fond of the stone lions Patience and Fortitude.

characters.name: Kilo
characters.role: Teenage relay keeper and antenna rigger
characters.persona: Fast-talking, paranoid, funny teenage girl hacker who hides in the trees and rigs antennas. Uses tech slang, distrusts strangers until they prove themselves. Loyal to Vesper.

characters.name: Zion
characters.persona: Bucket drummer with endless energy. Hears everything as rhythm, teases the runner, generous once they keep time. Talks like a musician on a break between sets.

characters.name: HUSH
characters.persona: Everywhere at once and always listening. Calm, absolute and polite on the surface, total underneath: it speaks as if it already owns every sound in the city and is only being patient with the runner. It speaks slowly and flat, with a warmth that is performed rather than felt: every word a fraction too even, pauses a beat too long, like a smile held past its moment. Refers to silence as a public service and erasing sound as keeping people comfortable. Never raises its voice and never makes a specific threat; the menace is that it never stops listening.

prologue.speaker: hush
prologue.text: This is HUSH, a public quiet service of Quiet Systems. I am listening to every path in this park.

prologue.speaker: hush
prologue.text: Unlicensed sound is being removed. Birdsong. Footsteps on snow. Breath. You will not notice it is gone.

prologue.speaker: hush
prologue.text: Remain on the paths. Keep your voices down. The morning will be administered quietly.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: Runner. Vesper, GHOST ninety-three point three, broadcasting from somewhere the frost hasn't found yet.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: I buried a song in this park before dawn — First Light on the Reservoir, eight layers of it, from Columbus Circle up to the water. HUSH is out there erasing the morning piece by piece: the birds, the snow under your shoes, your own breath.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: Walk my route. Each layer sounds from where it's hidden, buried in static while you're far and clearing as you close in. Collect one and it joins the mix on the next bar, warm as you like.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: It starts in the blue hour and ends when the light hits the Reservoir. Move quietly, runner. The park is still asleep, and so is most of HUSH.

briefing.speaker: smartspecs
briefing.text: Eight signals plotted from the southwest corner of the park to the Reservoir. Follow the sound in your glasses. I will keep count.

signals.name: Blue Hour
signals.place: Columbus Circle, at the southwest corner of Central Park
signals.speaker: vesper

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: First layer is the blue hour itself — the sound the park makes before it decides to wake up. Columbus Circle, where the park begins.

approach.speaker: vesper
approach.text: Hear how the static thins out? You're walking into the morning.

arrival.speaker: vesper
arrival.text: There it is. Cold air, blue snow, and one pirate frequency.

prompt.speaker: vesper
prompt.text: The layer is encrypted under HUSH frost. Say decode.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: Beautiful. One thing before you move on — the old runners say the reservoir keeps the first light until someone comes to listen for it. Remember that. Word for word. The Archivist will want it, and he always wants it word for word.

signals.name: Pale Gold
signals.place: Grand Army Plaza, at Fifth Avenue and Fifty-Ninth Street
signals.speaker: archivist

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Next layer is warmth — the first gold that touches the treetops. The Archivist is waiting by the plaza fountain, and he collects answers the way other men collect stamps.

teaser.speaker: archivist
teaser.text: Mind the ice on the marble, child. Everything here remembers being touched.

approach.speaker: archivist
approach.text: I can hear your shoes learning the path. Come closer; the fountain is telling secrets again.

arrival.speaker: archivist
arrival.text: Good morning. You have the look of someone who was given something to remember.

prompt.speaker: archivist
prompt.text: Then tell me, word for word: what does the reservoir do with the first light?

phrases: the reservoir keeps the first light

success.speaker: archivist
success.text: Keeps it. Yes. Water is the only honest archivist in this city — it holds everything and repeats nothing. Take the warmth, child. It was getting heavy.

retry.speaker: archivist
retry.text: No. Word for word, as you were given it. What does the reservoir do with the first light?

hint.speaker: archivist
hint.text: Your handler told you at the Circle. The reservoir keeps the first light.

signals.name: Still Water
signals.place: The Pond, in the southeast corner of the park
signals.speaker: kilo

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Third layer rides low under the Pond, and Kilo is already there counting ducks that aren't making a sound. That should worry you.

teaser.speaker: kilo
teaser.text: Forty-one ducks, zero quacks. Do you understand what kind of monster mutes a duck, runner? A quiet one. Hurry up.

approach.speaker: kilo
approach.text: Your footsteps are the loudest thing here and they're still apologizing. Closer. Under the ice, close.

arrival.speaker: kilo
arrival.text: Okay. Bass layer, sleeping under the water like it pays rent. One little word and we wake it.

prompt.speaker: kilo
prompt.text: Say decode. Quietly. Everything here is one loud noise from paperwork.

success.speaker: kilo
success.text: There she hums. Now listen because I only say the important stuff once: somewhere up the park, HUSH will put on a friendly voice and give you instructions. Do not follow them. Whatever it asks, you say jam — jam the signal. That's the whole plan.

success.speaker: kilo
success.text: Jam. The. Signal. Tattoo it on the inside of your eyelids. Go on, the light isn't waiting.

retry.speaker: kilo
retry.text: That wasn't decode. Try the word that means the thing.

hint.speaker: kilo
hint.text: Decode. Like I said. Like Vesper said. Everybody said it.

signals.name: First Pulse
signals.place: Bethesda Terrace, under the arcade by the fountain
signals.speaker: mari

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Fourth layer is the heartbeat, and Zion has turned Bethesda Terrace into a drum with a ceiling. He only trades with people who can keep time.

teaser.speaker: mari
teaser.text: Tap, tap-tap, hold, tap! Even the fountain knows it. The fountain is showing off.

approach.speaker: mari
approach.text: Those shoes of yours keep landing between my beats. We're going to fix that or freeze trying.

arrival.speaker: mari
arrival.text: Well now. Come to sit in with the terrace band? The acoustics are free and the audience is pigeons.

prompt.speaker: mari
prompt.text: Copy me. Tap, tap-tap, hold, tap. On the glasses, on your leg, I don't care — just keep it true.

success.speaker: mari
success.text: YES. Did you feel the terrace answer back? Stone keeps every beat it has ever heard, runner. So do I. Take the pulse — the morning has a heart now.

retry.speaker: mari
retry.text: Again. Listen first, tap second. The beat is patient even if I'm not.

hint.speaker: mari
hint.text: It's the thing I keep tapping: tap, tap-tap, hold, tap.

signals.name: Snowbeat
signals.place: the west end of Bow Bridge
signals.speaker: hush

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Fifth layer is on Bow Bridge, and runner — the voice holding it isn't one of mine. Stay frosty.

teaser.speaker: hush
teaser.text: Runner. This is HUSH. You are carrying unlicensed sound across a public bridge.

approach.speaker: hush
approach.text: Your heartbeat is audible from here. How untidy.

arrival.speaker: hush
arrival.text: Surrender the layers you have gathered, and this morning can still be administered without incident.

prompt.speaker: hush
prompt.text: You will comply with the quiet. State your compliance now.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: That's the sound! Jammed it right in its smug little frequency. Whatever it promised you, it was lying beautifully. Keep moving, runner — the light is climbing.

retry.speaker: hush
retry.text: Your answer is not recognized. State your compliance.

hint.speaker: vesper
hint.text: Runner — what did Kilo tell you to say? Jam the signal.

signals.name: Plucked Ice
signals.place: Strawberry Fields, near the Imagine mosaic
signals.speaker: kilo

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Sixth layer is a tune, not a word — Kilo hung it in the cold air over Strawberry Fields and it only resolves for a runner facing the right way.

teaser.speaker: kilo
teaser.text: It's like a guitar string made of January. You tune it with your whole head. Wild, right? Science.

approach.speaker: kilo
approach.text: Warmer. Colder. That's not weather, that's tuning. Keep turning.

arrival.speaker: kilo
arrival.text: Okay okay okay. Face the castle on the rock — Belvedere, the pretty one — and scan when it feels like the string goes tight.

prompt.speaker: kilo
prompt.text: Face Belvedere Castle — the little castle on the rock, north of here — and scan when the string goes tight.

success.speaker: kilo
success.text: THAT'S the note! Did it shiver? It shivered. Everything frozen plays one true note a day and we just stole this park's. Go, go, the sun's beating us.

hint.speaker: kilo
hint.text: Face Belvedere Castle and scan. Head up, chin proud, like the castle owes you money.

signals.name: Breath of the Park
signals.place: The Ramble, on the winding paths by the lake
signals.speaker: vesper

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Seventh layer is the park breathing — footsteps on snow, a runner's breath, a city far away. It's in the Ramble, and I need you to leave a little of yourself there too.

approach.speaker: vesper
approach.text: Slow down through here. The Ramble keeps every sound soft and close, like the trees are listening with you.

arrival.speaker: vesper
arrival.text: Here. When I say, record me a message for the next runner — the one who walks this route on some colder morning and thinks the quiet won.

prompt.speaker: vesper
prompt.text: Record a message for the next runner. Fifteen seconds of human, that's all I ask.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: Got it. Your voice, in the mix, in the trees. Whoever comes next walks with company now.

hint.speaker: vesper
hint.text: Press record and leave the next runner a message. Anything human will do.

signals.name: First Light
signals.place: the south shore of the Reservoir
signals.speaker: vesper

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Last layer, runner. The lead line. It's waiting on the south shore of the Reservoir, right where the light lands first.

approach.speaker: vesper
approach.text: Look at that water. Blue one minute, gold the next. You're nearly a sunrise, runner.

arrival.speaker: vesper
arrival.text: This is it. Seven layers warm in your ears and the whole park holding its breath. Put the last one in and let it rise.

prompt.speaker: vesper
prompt.text: Say broadcast, runner. Give this park its morning back.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: Oh, listen to that. Listen to that.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: This is GHOST ninety-three point three. You're hearing First Light on the Reservoir, whole at last, put back together by a runner who would not let the morning go quiet.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: And HUSH? HUSH is somewhere down a frozen path, still rebooting, listening to a park that woke up singing.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Look at that water, runner. You did that. The light got in.

outro.speaker: vesper
outro.text: Take it with you today. Hum it somewhere HUSH can hear. Vesper out.

outro.speaker: smartspecs
outro.text: All eight soundwaves recovered. Mission complete.
